name: Azuma
source:
A young man living his unchanging days with disinterest while working part-time at a convenience store. His good looks are the only thing he has going for him. He acts cheerful but internally he’s quite subdued. He has no real dreams or ambitions, but passes the long days with content. He’s a frugal sort who can be happy over something like the butcher shop he frequents putting chicken meat on sale. He’s participating in the tour after winning the trip from the lottery drawing in the shopping district.

[Source [URL=http://pilslash.jp/product/paradise/chara/]official website profile[/URL].]
